title: Team
description: A professional team identity. Confirmed fields map 1:1 to VCT Reference `teams`.

teamId.description: PV canonical team id. For VCT Reference rows this is the stringified teams.team_id (a stable integer id).

name.description: Team display name. VCT Reference teams.team_name.

country.description: Region/country code, e.g. 'eu', 'br'. VCT Reference teams.country.
